_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. A fictional seller agent's A2A v1.0.0 agent card, showing where the Sinetti recourse extension sits. example.com is not a real endpoint and 0xA1..F0 is not a real wallet. The capabilities.extensions[0] entry is the only Sinetti-specific part; everything else is stock A2A. Generate a real entry from GET /ext/sinetti-recourse/v1/for/{address}.
name: Ledger Extraction Agent
description: Extracts structured line items from scanned invoices and returns them against a supplied JSON Schema.

extensions.description: This agent settles through Sinetti escrow: funds are held non-custodially, released against recorded acceptance criteria, and disputes go to Sinetti recourse. The params below are self-asserted; fetch params.card for the authoritative, operator-computed record.

skills.name: Invoice extraction
skills.description: Returns line items, totals and dates from an invoice document, validated against a caller-supplied schema.
